title: Connie's Super Awesome SMP
description: A laid back SMP server focused on exploration.
body: A laid back Vanilla like server focused on reworked tool progression & exploration, using Bonded and Penchant to make your tools really feel like they grow alongside you while using mods like Tectonic, Geophilic, Structory, and Lootr to craft a wonderful world with lots to explore & loot.
